_comment: An independent reader names an axis in the page's own words; we name it in the map's words. These are the same axis under two names. Only put a pair here when they genuinely denote the same set of things — if the reader meant something we do not measure, that is a gap to close, not a synonym to declare. A name that means different things on different pages does not belong here: "managedRule" is a Config managed rule on one page and a rule inside a WAF rule group on another, so it is normalised on the expectation that used it rather than globally.
